observations.rationale: The requirements file consists of a local self-install dot reference. It is not a named dependency version range, while the AI025 predicate describes a direct dependency allowing version movement. The fresh v0.12 before scan still reports it.
observations.recommended_action: Exclude narrowly recognized local requirement paths while retaining named unpinned dependency checks.

observations.rationale: api_key_env_var receives the name of an environment variable, while the adjacent api_key reads the value from the environment. This is a credential-source identifier, not a literal credential.
observations.recommended_action: Exclude explicit environment-variable-name field roles with paired real-secret tests.

observations.rationale: The recognized token-shaped literal appears in documentation and its suffix repeats one placeholder character. The standalone key-format detector bypasses the existing placeholder test.
observations.recommended_action: Reject narrowly defined repeated-character token placeholders without suppressing arbitrary documentation or realistic random-looking literals.

observations.rationale: The selected yaml.load call explicitly supplies yaml.BaseLoader. A broad loader-API warning is not the same as the object-construction predicate of Invarune AI004.
observations.recommended_action: Do not introduce a detector just to reproduce this broader tool observation.

observations.rationale: The selected tar extraction call explicitly uses filter="data". Invarune AI037 is scoped to absence of a safe filter or an explicitly fully-trusted filter.
observations.recommended_action: Retain the safe-filter distinction; validate other archive resource limits separately.

observations.rationale: The call uses a typed tarfile.TarFile parameter named tf rather than a locally constructed receiver. The helper checks member paths, link destinations and member types before extractall. Recognizing the type annotation could identify a no-filter API call, but would not establish a vulnerability through these checks.
observations.recommended_action: Record the local type-inference boundary; do not call the unmatched API observation a confirmed missed vulnerability.

observations.rationale: This call is zipfile.ZipFile.extractall behind member-path validation. The current Invarune AI037 detector is scoped to tar extraction behavior, not all ZIP extraction calls.
observations.recommended_action: Keep scope explicit; any new ZIP rule requires its own positive/negative fixtures and security predicate.

observations.rationale: The outbound call receives a locally constructed urllib Request from a signed_url function parameter. The direct literal-input heuristic does not follow this argument flow, and the excerpt does not establish who controls the signed URL or deployment egress.
observations.recommended_action: Retain as unknown applicability until caller/dataflow evidence is reviewed. Do not infer SSRF from tool agreement.

review_scope: Small purposive review to distinguish actionable detector precision gaps from competitor predicate/scope differences. Not a full adjudication, independent ground truth or production accuracy sample.
